scenes.caption: A diary.
scenes.say: Zainab starts a weather diary in Lahore.

scenes.caption: Monday.
scenes.say: On Monday it is sunny and very hot.

scenes.caption: Wednesday.
scenes.say: On Wednesday the sky fills with grey clouds.

scenes.caption: Windy.
scenes.say: On Thursday the wind blows her kite.

scenes.caption: Monsoon.
scenes.say: On Friday the monsoon rain arrives.

scenes.caption: Rain gauge.
scenes.say: The rain gauge fills up. She measures the rain.

scenes.caption: A table.
scenes.say: She puts all the days in a weather table.

scenes.caption: A season.
scenes.say: Summer in Lahore has the monsoon. Weather follows the seasons.
